dict.string: ThaibaHive requires NFC access to scan and register staff cards and location checkpoints.
ThaibaHive requires location access to verify staff attendance punches within designated institution geofences.
ThaibaHive requires background location access to verify staff presence within campus boundaries during scheduled duty shifts.
ThaibaHive requires camera access to scan institution QR codes for attendance verification and student identity badges.
ThaibaHive requires microphone access to enable voice query navigation in the campus copilot assistant.
ThaibaHive requires photo library access to allow staff and students to upload profile pictures and document attachments.
ThaibaHive uses Face ID to securely authenticate administrative operations and biometric session unlocks.
